name: Number of dependencies

name: Number of positive dependencies

name: Negative dependency ratio

name: Top-1 rule weight

name: Weak-rule regime score

name: Total positive dependency mass
note: 正依赖权重总量越大，潜在增益越大

name: Average rules per candidate

name: Top-k rule weight

name: Top-k synergy weight

name: Net dependency mass
note: 净依赖质量越高，预期越有利

name: Number of candidates

name: Number of fired rules
